'''Asset R-3''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Revanite" /> member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. R-3 held a position in the bureaucracy of the Republic,<ref name="State" /> and in [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was about to acquire a communique from a prominent Imperial figure to a Republic captain and reported his impending acquisition to the Shroud. However, before he could acquire the message,<ref name="Revanite" /> R-3 was framed for accepting bribes from constituents and was thus arrested by the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], and the asset's [[Death/Legends|death]] prompted the Shroud to send [[Asset R-10]] to investigate.<ref name="State" /> The Shroud initially assumed a possible defection by the Imperial, but later evidence pointed to the [[Order of Revan]]'s agents.<ref name="Revanite" />
